claims.verbatim:
Steamship Borussia (Ham), Schwensen, Hamburg April 22,
with mdse and 751[?] passengers, to Kunhardt & Co. First part
of passage had light easterly winds, the latter strong west-
erly; May 6, 1:30 AM, lat 40 25, lon 70 47, passed steamships
Allemania and Hermann, bound E.

claims.verbatim:
Steamship New York (Brem), Ernst, Bremen April 22,
Southampton 25th, at 3 PM, with mdse and 734 passengers,
to Oelrichs & Co. May 1, lat 45 57, lon 40 44, passed ship
Orision[?], bound W; 2d, lat 44 7, lon 46 4, bark Edward (Prus),
bound W, and a steamship, with Inman's signal, apparently
the City of Manchester, bound W; lat 42 53, lon 49[?] 52, AM,
steamship Baltic, bound E; 6th, lat 40 40, lon 68 42, American
ship Star of the West, from Liverpool for New York; lat 40
38, lon 69[?] 19, steamships Hermann (Brem), and Allemania
(Ham), bound E; also the steamship City of London (Br),
bound E.

claims.verbatim:
There was a larger
export of treasure than usual to Europe by this day's
steamers, the total aggregating $991,515, of which
about $600,000 was in bar gold and silver. The Her-
mann took of this amount $221,300, the Allemania
$63,000, the City of London $311,000, the Malta $250,615
and the Lafayette $145,600. The export for the week
has been $1,247,240.
